scope: Targeted new-family source read; not a refresh of every historical source.

rows.claim: Standard UIKit controls provide accessibility support; customize only for a specific contextual need. This supports preserving existing controls, not assuming defects.
The preference getter reports the enabled state. Final-message timing and the injected test reader are application policy, not a promise made by the getter.
An adjustable element implements increment behavior. Range, disabled guard, callback timing and ordinary buttons are explicitly stated fixture requirements.
The trait describes an element unavailable for interaction. The example updates it alongside the disabled guard; tests assert stored configuration, not an announcement.
rows.note: The page supplies no numeric iOS introduction date; none is inferred.
